description: This file defines the ProductOptionValueService interface, which declares methods for managing ProductOptionValue entities within the sales manager system. It includes method signatures for saving, retrieving by name, ID, code, and listing product option values associated with a merchant store, with support for localization via language parameter.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductOptionValue or updates an existing one, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues by name within a specific MerchantStore and language context.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its ID within a MerchantStore context.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all ProductOptionValues associated with a given MerchantStore and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Lists all ProductOptionValues associated with a given MerchantStore that are not read-only, filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its code within a MerchantStore.
